All five tests pass. The bug was in the order of operations for flat coupons: the code was subtracting the coupon amount from the already-converted total instead of subtracting it from the USD subtotal before converting.

The fix ensures that flat coupons—always stored in USD—are subtracted before currency conversion happens. For a $10 flat coupon on a $100 order in EUR, it now correctly calculates `(100 - 10) × 0.9 = 81`, instead of the wrong `100 × 0.9 - 10 = 80`.

Run the tests with:

```
node --test tests/pricing.test.js
```
